🌟 Exciting News! 🌟

I'm thrilled to share that I've officially become a member of the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee! 🎉 After working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I'm incredibly excited to take on this new role and help drive the development and adoption of this pivotal healthcare technology forward.

CDS Hooks plays a vital role in enhancing clinical decision support by enabling seamless integration within EHRs, and I'm passionate about contributing to its evolution and success.

If you're already using CDS Hooks, I'd love for you to share your implementation with the community. Please add it to our growing list of use cases at [CDS Hooks Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability).

And if you haven't adopted CDS Hooks yet, don't miss out on the opportunity to improve your clinical workflows. I'm available as a freelance consultant to assist you in implementing this transformative standard and enhancing your healthcare solutions.

Here's to advancing healthcare together! 🚀

#CDSHooks #HealthcareInnovation #ClinicalDecisionSupport #HealthIT #EHRIntegration #Consulting #HealthcareTransformation
